title: OBLT AW agentic assets (apm.yml extension)
description: Extension block x-oblt-aw in consumer apm.yml. Each org key (e.g. obs, docs) owns common and workflows; workflow ids match config/<org-key>/workflow-registry.json. Use inner-workflows.<basename> when several control-plane wrappers share one registry id.

fragments.description: Local fragment id to repo-relative Markdown path.

common.description: Assets shared by all agentic workflows for this org when no workflow-specific block exists.

workflows.description: Per-workflow assets for this org. When a workflow id is present, common is ignored entirely (override). Prefer inner-workflows when wrappers share one id.

setup-commands.description: Inline shell commands (string or list). Multiline strings are split into one command per non-empty, non-comment line. List entries may be script paths or arbitrary shell.

setup-commands-file.description: Repo-relative path to a UTF-8 file with one shell command per line (same line splitting as setup-commands).

additional-instructions-fragments.description: Ordered fragment ids from the org fragments map; materialized before inline additional-instructions.

inputs.description: Overrides for agentic workflow inputs (kebab-case keys). Values may be scalars or *-file paths.

setup-commands-file.description: Repo-relative path to a UTF-8 file with one shell command per line (same line splitting as setup-commands).

additional-instructions-fragments.description: Ordered fragment ids from the org fragments map; materialized before inline additional-instructions.

inputs.description: Overrides for agentic workflow inputs (kebab-case keys). Values may be scalars or *-file paths.

inner-workflows.description: Per control-plane wrapper basename assets when several wrappers share this workflow id. When the running basename matches, that block overrides the parent workflow block.
